capabilities: Schedule question::answer cards with SM-2-style spaced repetition
Require typed attempts and confidence ratings before revealing answers
Unlock notes one step at a time along a topic's MOC learning path
Award XP and levels with daily goals, streaks and per-topic progress
Prompt deep-processing explanations and save them into the note
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README states all data stays in the vault and the plugin makes no network requests.
motivation: The author wanted flashcard practice that goes beyond show-and-rate by adding the learning mechanics research says make memory last.
problem: Flashcard tools in Obsidian stop at showing the answer and asking for a rating, without active retrieval, confidence checks, adaptive difficulty or deep-processing prompts.

relations.evidence: The card syntax is the same question::answer line format used by the Spaced Repetition plugin, so existing cards work as-is.

summary: Spaced retrieval practice plugin that schedules question::answer cards with typed attempts, confidence ratings, n+1 unlocking, an 85% difficulty target and XP levels.
